next_action.description: Implement MPI-404. Its blocking question is ANSWERED - the models root stays ENGINE-OWNED, so the fix is that the home hero must not claim a count it cannot have (MODELS 0 / 18 is heroStats.js _renderModels(installedCount = 0), the untouched initial value, not a measurement). Read .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-404/brief.md FIRST for the decision and the explicit do-nots, then the card description for the full root-cause trace. Do NOT persist the models root app-side, do NOT touch getCustomRoot / who writes extra_model_paths.yaml / the engine:ready gate on syncModelInstalled. The absorbed MPI-405 half (Stage-all-models toggle live with no API key) ships on the same card. Move the card todo -> doing before editing any file.

key_decisions: MPI-404 DECIDED 2026-08-05 by the user: the models root stays ENGINE-OWNED. The alternative (an app-level models-root setting that outlives the engine, with extra_model_paths.yaml written FROM it) was rejected as too big for 1.4. The hero simply must not assert a count it cannot compute. If an app-level root is ever wanted it is a product card of its own.
MPI-453 SCOPE (built): gate the mechanism, do NOT split Wan 2.2 into two Library entries. Per-op deps are the deliberate design and MPI-449's MiniMax H3 is the next consumer.

MPI-453 root, CORRECTED from the card text: the PromptBox strip DOES consult deriveInstalledOps. The drift was one layer up - the Blocks seeded activeOperation from the static supportedOps[0], so the block's selection and what the strip offered could disagree. Fixed at all three MpiGalleryBlock fallbacks, plus the remembered op, plus MpiGroupHistoryBlock._opOptions, plus a pre-dispatch gate in commandExecutor.

installedOpsForContext returns NULL, never [], when the dep-status cache is unseeded. Null means unknown and getAvailableCommands falls back to the static supportedOps; [] would hide every op on a cold boot (MPI-122's contract). Do not 'simplify' that away.
MPI-450 IS the pre-release. One GitHub-only release flow, no pre-release tier, so the umbrella is the gate list rather than a release channel.

MPI-420: a missing TAESD decoder does NOT remove previews - latent_preview.py falls back to Latent2RGB, the blocky colour blob. And Krea 2 is NOT Flux-latent: read the latent format out of comfy/supported_models.py, never off a model's transformer lineage.
Gate B runs AFTER the version bump and build on purpose: MPI-249 tests the ARTIFACT, and verifying a dev checkout does not verify a build.
constraints: MPI-454 (Composite Place) is NOT in this umbrella and must not be pulled in - it is a peer's feature card, blocked by MPI-377, and MPI-377 is on MPI-450's explicit not-in-1.4 list (brief.md line 75).

NEVER add a dep whose filename starts with lighttaew - ComfyUI #13366 corrupts real generations on the Wan21/Wan22/Qwen family. A test in tests/remote-engine-assets.test.cjs fails on it. The bytes ARE staged on R2 so re-adding the dep is the whole job the day PR #13383 lands in our engine version.

A peer agent commits into this tree LIVE. It created MPI-454 mid-session and edited MPI-449/research.md and js/utils/ratios.js. Re-status right before committing and commit ONLY your own paths; board.json and the global events.jsonl are co-owned.

Board timestamps run AHEAD of the real clock (peer sessions on a VPN exit node). Never 'correct' a peer timestamp, never regress board.json updated_at - keep stamping forward from the highest value present. This session stamped up to 2026-08-05T12:10:00Z.

Every card move must CREATE the files its links declare, and validate_board.py PASSES in this repo - a non-zero exit is your own violation. Run it as 'validate_board.py .' from the REPO ROOT (passing the kanban dir is a false pass at exit 0) and never through a pipe.
Three live checks are the USER's, not an agent's: MPI-453 (Wan 2.2 with only i2v installed), MPI-420 (one Klein + one Wan generation), MPI-374 (a full restart).
